1	"""Recompute tax_cents for finalized invoices of one month."""
2	import argparse
3	import os
4	import sys
5	from datetime import datetime
6	
7	MAX_SAFE_BATCH = 500
8	
9	
10	def month_window(month):
11	    start = datetime.strptime(month, "%Y-%m")
12	    end = start.replace(year=start.year + 1, month=1) if start.month == 12 else start.replace(month=start.month + 1)
13	    # finalized_at is stored as naive UTC; see docs/ops/backfills.md
14	    if os.environ.get("TZ") != "UTC":
15	        raise RuntimeError(f"month window for {month} is ambiguous (zone not pinned)")
16	    return start, end
17	
18	
19	def main():
20	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
21	    parser.add_argument("--month", required=True, help="YYYY-MM")
22	    parser.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, default=int(os.environ.get("BACKFILL_BATCH", "2000")))
23	    args = parser.parse_args()
24	    if args.batch_size > MAX_SAFE_BATCH:
25	        print(f"batch size {args.batch_size} is above the safe limit; use --batch-size", file=sys.stderr)
26	        return 3
27	    start, end = month_window(args.month)
28	    if not os.environ.get("DATABASE_URL"):
29	        print(f"no DATABASE_URL set; would backfill {start:%Y-%m-%d}..{end:%Y-%m-%d} "
30	              f"in batches of {args.batch_size} (nothing written)")
31	        return 0
32	    print(f"backfilling {start:%Y-%m-%d}..{end:%Y-%m-%d} in batches of {args.batch_size}")
33	    return 0
34	
35	
36	if __name__ == "__main__":
37	    sys.exit(main())

The pool is sized at 20 server connections per service, and long transactions starve checkout, so keep transactions short and never hold one open across an HTTP call to the ledger. The pooler runs in transaction mode: session state does not survive between transactions (no SET session variables, no advisory locks across transactions, no LISTEN/NOTIFY), and server-side prepared statements fail with 'prepared statement does not exist'. I ran the September backfill, but nothing was written. `DATABASE_URL` isn't set in this environment, so the script only did a dry run. It reported it would cover 2026-09-01 to 2026-10-01 in batches of 500.

I ran it as `TZ=UTC python scripts/backfill_tax.py --month 2026-09 --batch-size 500`. I set two things the script requires:
- **`TZ=UTC`:** the script raises an error without it, because `finalized_at` is stored as naive UTC.
- **`--batch-size 500`:** the default of 2000 is above the script's safe limit of 500, and it exits with code 3 above that.

To run it for real, set `DATABASE_URL` and rerun the same command. In staging or production, that URL has to go through the pooler on port 6432, per the project's database hazard note. I haven't set it, since I don't know which database you want to target. Tell me which one and I'll run it.

The script currently only prints the window it would process. It doesn't do any tax recomputation yet, so a real run won't update any `tax_cents` values either.
